content_sections.heading: About Kamareddy Collectorate
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the Collector, Kamareddy District, under the Government of Telangana. It is signed on behalf of the District Collector. It fills backlog posts reserved for persons with disabilities (Divyangulu) in various departments of the district. Applications are received by the district's Women, Children, Disabled and Senior Citizens Department at the Collectorate.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application form (prescribed proforma) and other details are available on the Kamareddy district website, kamareddy.telangana.gov.in. The notice allows two ways to submit the completed application. By registered post: Put the completed application in a sealed cover and write the name of the post clearly on top of the cover. Send it by registered post within the deadline to: District Welfare Officer, Women, Children, Disabled and Senior Citizens Department, Room No.31, Collector Office, Kamareddy. Applications that arrive by registered post after the deadline will not be accepted. In person: Put the completed application in a sealed cover and write the post name clearly on top. Hand it in within the deadline to the same office: District Welfare Officer, Women, Children, Disabled and Senior Citizens Department, Room No.31, Collector Office, Kamareddy. Submit a separate application for each post you are eligible for. If one application names more than one post, it will be considered only for the post written first. Your cell number must be written in the application.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice lists 6 vacancies in four posts. All of them are backlog posts reserved for persons with disabilities. The notice's category columns are Blind, Deaf, Physically Disabled and Mentally Challenged / Multiple Disabilities. Only candidates of the disability category allotted to a post may apply for it. Applications from candidates of other categories will be rejected. The notice also says the number of vacancies may increase or decrease depending on circumstances. The notice does not mention the pay for any post. Age is counted as on 01 July 2026. It is set under G.O.Ms.No.86, dated 18-05-2026, GAD (Ser-B) Department and G.O.Ms.No.51, dated 10-11-2021, Department for WCD&SC (Sch.II). Candidates must have completed a minimum age of 18 years. Their age should not exceed 54 years. The disability certificate rule follows G.O.Ms.No.31, Women Development & Child Welfare (DW) Department, dated 01.12.2009. Under it, candidates must enclose a certificate confirming at least 40% disability with the application. Candidates must have studied for any four (4) consecutive years between 1st class and 7th class in Kamareddy district. They must submit the related certificate. Blind and deaf candidates who studied in special schools have an extra rule under G.O.Ms.No.104, GAD Department, dated 2000-03-24. To establish local status, they must enclose their parents' residence certificates along with the relevant study certificates. Candidates who do not submit these documents will be treated as non-local. Candidates should check the official notification for the disability category allotted to each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Copies of educational certificates, attested by a Gazetted Officer Copies of date-of-birth documents (SSC certificate, birth certificate, Aadhaar card and similar), attested by a Gazetted Officer Copy of the Employment card, attested by a Gazetted Officer Study certificate and marks memo for the qualification prescribed for the post Disability certificate confirming at least 40% disability Study certificates showing four consecutive years of study (1st to 7th class) in Kamareddy district. Blind and deaf candidates from special schools must also enclose parents' residence certificates. Two recent passport size photographs: paste one on the front of the application and sign across it with an ink pen; pin the other to the application Unattested copies will not be accepted. An application that does not include any of these documents will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice sets out a marks-based recruitment method for these non-Group-IV posts. It does not mention a written test or an interview. Two rules apply when merit is equal, under G.O.Ms.No.56 WDCW&DW Dept., dated 02.12.2002. First, the candidate with the higher percentage of disability gets preference. If the disability percentage is also equal, the older candidate gets preference.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Kamareddy Collectorate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 backlog posts for persons with disabilities: 2 Office Subordinate, 1 Cook, 2 Kamati and 1 Watchman. The number may increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted from 25 November 2026 to 11 December 2026. Applications that arrive by registered post after the deadline are not accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: Office Subordinate requires a pass in 7th class. Cook, Kamati and Watchman require the ability to read and write (up to 5th class).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must be at least 18 years old and must not be older than 54 years, as on 01 July 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Who can apply for these backlog posts?
faq.answer: Only persons with disabilities can apply, with a certificate showing at least 40% disability. Each candidate may apply only for posts allotted to his or her own disability category.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Put the completed proforma and attested documents in a sealed cover with the post name written on top. Send it by registered post, or hand it in, to the District Welfare Officer, Women, Children, Disabled and Senior Citizens Department, Room No.31, Collector Office, Kamareddy.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Office Subordinate is selected on 100 marks: 80 for qualification marks, 10 for disability percentage and 10 for age. Cook, Kamati and Watchman are selected on 20 marks: 10 for disability percentage and 10 for age.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for more than one post in one application?
faq.answer: No. A single application listing several posts is considered only for the post named first, so a separate application is needed for each post.

faq.question: Q9. Do I need to be a local candidate of Kamareddy district?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must have studied any four consecutive years from 1st to 7th class in Kamareddy district and submit the certificate. Blind and deaf candidates from special schools must also submit parents' residence certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I get the application form?
faq.answer: The application form and other details are available on the Kamareddy district website, kamareddy.telangana.gov.in.
